About the numbers

Størrelse, bemanning, barnehagelærere, areal, pedagognorm, åpningstid og matpenger er fra Barnehagefakta (Utdanningsdirektoratet). Beskrivelse, mat, årsplan og nettside er fra barnehagenes sider hos Oslo kommune. Hentet 4. november 2026. Fargene på nøkkeltallene viser avvik fra snittet i bydelen, målt i standardavvik, på samme måte som foreldrenes svar.

The order is based on the national Parent Survey (Utdanningsdirektoratet), what you chose as most important, and the distance from home. Kindergartens your child's siblings already attend always come first.

Each kindergarten is compared with the others in the same district in Oslo, or the same municipality outside Oslo. We measure how far above or below the average it is, in standard deviations: more than one standard deviation above is “well above average”, half a standard deviation is “above average”. With fewer than 10 parent answers the rating is pulled towards the average. Districts and municipalities with fewer than five kindergartens with answers are compared with all the kindergartens in Tassen. The trend over time goes back to 2018 and shows the parents' overall rating, on the same 1 to 5 scale every year.

Open places now come from Oslo kommune's list, collected by the open project ledige-barnehageplasser-oslo. The chance of a place is an estimate based on the places the kindergarten announced at the 2026 main admission. The municipality does not publish the number of applicants per kindergarten.

Walking times are approximate and measured from the point you picked. Profile (nature and outdoor life, farm, Montessori and so on) and which groups private kindergartens probably admit first (housing co-op, students, staff, congregation, co-op members) are read from the kindergarten's name. Always check the articles of association. District boundaries from Oslo kommune.

Bærum: nøkkeltall fra Barnehagefakta, foreldreundersøkelsen fra Utdanningsdirektoratet (2023–2026), og beskrivelse og mat fra Bærum kommunes sider. Hentet 10. november 2026. Bærum-barnehagene sammenlignes med snittet i Bærum. Bærum publiserer ikke hvor mange plasser hver barnehage lyste ut, så sjansen for plass vises som ukjent. Kommunegrense fra Kartverket.

Asker, Lillestrøm, Lørenskog and Nordre Follo: key figures from Barnehagefakta and the Parent Survey from Utdanningsdirektoratet (2023–2026). Collected 18 November 2026. We don't have descriptions and food from the municipalities' pages here, so food is shown as not stated, and visit mode asks about it. The kindergartens are compared with the average in their municipality. Municipal borders from Kartverket, primary schools from the national school register and the transport network from Entur.

Guides and reports: how to apply, when your child has the right to a place, price and food fee, and lists of kindergartens that stand out.

The right to a place follows Oslo kommune's rules: children who turn one by the end of August have the right from August; children who turn one in September to November have it from that month.
